key.name: selected-layout
key.description: The layout to open when Wallmat starts without an explicit --layout argument.

key.name: last-filter
key.description: The text filter restored when Wallmat starts in normal UI mode.

key.name: sort-mode
key.description: The sort mode restored when Wallmat starts in normal UI mode: name, newest, oldest, random, or folder grouping.

key.name: favorites-only
key.description: Whether to restore the favorites-only filter in normal UI mode.

key.name: auto-rotate-interval
key.description: Interval used by session auto-rotation: 60, 300, 600, or 1800 seconds.

key.name: recent-random-wallpapers
key.description: Wallpaper paths excluded from random selection until the recent pool is exhausted.

key.name: random-history-limit
key.description: Number of recently selected wallpapers to avoid in random selection; zero disables history.

key.name: scan-depth
key.description: Maximum nested directory depth to scan; zero scans all readable subdirectories.

key.name: applied-wallpaper-history
key.description: Up to fifty wallpaper paths applied most recently, used for Previous navigation.

key.name: selected-wallpaper
key.description: Absolute path of the last selected wallpaper, restored only when the file remains available in the current filtered results.

key.name: recent-wallpapers
key.description: Up to eight recently selected existing wallpaper paths, shown when they belong to the currently opened folder.
